messages.subject: Re: rstudio runApp greys out (probably due to ufw rules)
parts:
Andrew,

I am sure you have seen this article on how to run RStudio Server with proxy (linking it here just in case):

https://support.rstudio.com/hc/en-us/articles/200552326-Running-with-a-Proxy

And your setup seems to be working in general. The issue is that you need some additional configuration to redirect websocket calls. This is a configuratin that works with Apache web server:

```
ProxyPassMatch ^/p/([0-9]+)/websocket/$ ws://localhost:8787/p/$1/websocket/
ProxyPass / http://localhost:8787/
ProxyPassReverse /http://localhost:8787/
ProxyRequests Off
```

The first line is needed for Shiny applications (runApp) to work within a proxy environment. You would need a similar configuration with Nginx. (I am not very familiar with Nginx syntax, but I am sure you can figure that out.)

The other thing is that depending on the Linux system you are using, you might need to enable some additional modules for websocket. For example on CentOS 7 you would need this module: proxy_wstunnel

Hope this helps,
Fereshteh
